title: Mailbox/query silently ignores client sort request, always sorts by id string
description: mailbox.rs:210: matching.sort_by(|a, b| a.as_ref().cmp(b.as_ref())); This hardcodes sort by id regardless of any 'sort' field in the client request. RFC 8621 §2.3 defines comparator fields for Mailbox/query: name, parentId, role, sortOrder, totalEmails, unreadEmails, totalThreads, unreadThreads. A client that sends sort=[{property:'name'}] gets results sorted by id string instead. The sort field is not even parsed from args. Fix: parse the sort field and apply it, or return an unsupportedSort error if sorting is not supported.
